name: Ladera Resort

address.street: Rabot Estate Soufriere Post Office Jalousle

insider_take: Where luxury meets nature in the most dramatic way possible – each suite has only three walls, opening directly to the iconic Pitons and Caribbean Sea below.
whats_special: Ladera Resort is the only resort in Saint Lucia where every suite features an open-wall design (missing the fourth wall) for unobstructed views of the UNESCO World Heritage Pitons. The property sits 1,100 feet above sea level on a former cocoa plantation, offering the most photographed vista in the Caribbean. Each suite comes with a private plunge pool and is constructed using local hardwoods and stone.
pro_tip: Book the Hilltop Suite for the most dramatic Pitons views, and time your arrival for late afternoon when the golden light creates perfect photo opportunities of the twin volcanic peaks.
dont_miss: The award-winning Dasheene Restaurant serves Caribbean-French fusion cuisine with panoramic Pitons views – sunset dinner here is unforgettable. Take the complimentary shuttle to Sister Resort Sandals Grande St. Lucian for beach access, or explore the nearby Sulphur Springs volcano, just 10 minutes away.
pros: Spectacular open-air suites with missing fourth wall facing Piton mountains
UNESCO World Heritage Site location with breathtaking rainforest views
Intimate boutique property with personalized luxury service
Award-winning Dasheene restaurant featuring Caribbean fusion cuisine
cons: Remote mountainside location requiring travel to reach beaches
